description: This Java class represents the response to a 'ModifyAclEntry' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details such as the affected 'Thing' ID, the modified ACL entry, HTTP status, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization logic. The class deprecates version 1 of ACL APIs in favor of newer policies.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntryResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'ModifyAclEntry' command, including serialization, deserialization, and utility methods for handling the ACL modification response within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an ACL entry was created, with status code 201 (Created). Overloaded to accept a String or a ThingId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an ACL entry was modified, with status code 204 (No Content). Overloaded to accept a String or a ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyAclEntryResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object, along with headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity payload in JSON format based on the schema version if the response indicates creation.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON Pointer path for the ACL resource based on the authorization subject.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for this response.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality based on 'thingId' and 'modifiedAclEntry'.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, verifies object type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on 'thingId' and 'modifiedAclEntry'.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
